translation.title: Ciclopirox Gel
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for the local treatment of interdigital athlete's foot (tinea pedis between the toes or fingers) caused by dermatophytes, yeasts and molds, and of seborrheic dermatitis of the scalp.
translation.usage: For interdigital athlete's foot caused by dermatophytes, yeasts and molds, apply it to the infected area and the surrounding skin twice a day; even if the initial symptoms lessen, continue the treatment for 4 weeks to prevent recurrence. For the local treatment of seborrheic dermatitis of the scalp, apply it to the infected area twice a day for 4 weeks.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it. Do not use it in the eyes, on mucous membranes, inside the vagina, or on wounds. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before use for patients under 16 and if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. This medicine is for external use only. Adverse reactions such as contact dermatitis, dry skin, acne, rash, hair loss, pain on application, eye pain, facial swelling, a temporary burning feeling, skin flushing or itching may occur; if they do, stop use and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Store at room temperature and keep out of reach of children.
